info.howOne: Material Conversion requires 4–6 Rare-grade or higher Unbound equipment pieces. Every piece contributes points based on grade, tier, Prime status, and enhancement level.
info.howTwo: The combined points determine the Material Conversion Level in-game. The game can predict six possible results; predictions cost currency and can be repeated. One predicted item is awarded when conversion is performed.
info.rewardDescription: Some Circlet equipment, exclusive collection items, and Memory Chips can only be obtained through Material Conversion.
